newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Q1 insurance premiums up 10.5 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Q1 insurance premiums up 10.5 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Brazil's insurance premiums rose 4.1 billion reais in the first quarter, up 10.5 percent from the 3.7 billion reais, the National Federation of Insurance Companies (FENASEG) said in a statement.
The statement did not explain the rise in the three-month figures, which are adjusted for IGP-M inflation.
Fenaseg said automobile insurance premiums account for 30.6 percent of the total, health insurance for 21.7 percent and life 18.4 percent.
"Claims in these sectors also remain high at 70.3 percent, 72.2 percent and 44.9 percent respectively," the statement added.
Total claims in the Brazilian insurance market reached 64.0 percent, Fenaseg President Joao Eiseo Ferraz de Campos was quoted in the statement as saying.
Sales expenses continued relatively stable in the first three months, rising a mere 1.0 percent to 709 million reais from 702 million reais in the same period last year.
